title: Stimulus set for "Bilingual Prefabs: No switching cost was found in Canton-ese-English habitual codeswitching in Hong Kong"
descriptions: The set of stimulus used in "Bilingual Prefabs: No switching cost was found in Canton-ese-English habitual codeswitching in Hong Kong". It is designed for Hong Kong Cantonese speakers. English translation is provided, but not in strictly word-to-word manners.
